title: Lone strand, side lines at both flat ends
what: start_line_visible + end_line_visible (default). Footprint = flat-capped body + the two 4px side-line bars just past each end.

title: Lone curved strand, side lines
what: Same flags on a curved centreline: the side-line bars follow the end tangents.

title: Lone strand, side lines hidden
what: start_line_visible = end_line_visible = false. Footprint is exactly the flat-capped body: nothing beyond the ends.

title: Lone strand, only the start side line
what: end_line_visible = false. One end has the bar, the other is a bare flat cap.

title: Lone strand, stroke_width 12
what: A thick stroke makes the side-line bar (stroke_width thick) and the flat end obvious.

title: Parent strand: junction circle at its end
what: A child attaches at the end -> OSS draws a cap circle there (radius (w+2sw)/2). Footprint = body + start side line + full end circle.

title: Attached child: folded start circle + end side line
what: has_circles[0] with an opaque circle stroke -> full start circle in the footprint; free end keeps its side line (attached starts never get a start side line).

title: Attached child: UNFOLDED start (transparent circle stroke)
what: start_circle_stroke_color.a = 0 -> no outer circle, but the inner fill circle (radius w/2) is drawn and belongs to the footprint.

title: Parent: junction circle with transparent stroke
what: has_circles[1] but end_circle_stroke_color.a = 0 -> OSS draws no circle AND no side line (a circle "occupies" the end). Footprint = flat body only at that end.

title: Attached child: start circle hidden via layer menu
what: manual_circle_visibility[0] = false -> no start circle; an attached start never draws a side line either, so that end is a bare flat cap.

title: Middle of a chain: circles at both ends
what: Start = its own attachment circle, end = junction circle for the grandchild. Both full circles join the footprint.

title: Attached child: end circle forced on, nothing attached
what: has_circles[1] via manual override with no junction: draw() only adds the INNER end fill (radius w/2, no stroke ring). OSS puts exactly that inner circle in the footprint.

title: Closed knot: closed_connections circles
what: The child loops back onto the parent start; closed_connections marks both ends. Parent footprint = body + closing circle at start + junction circle at end.

title: MaskedStrand hovered in SELECT mode
what: OSS highlights the drawn mask (stroke layer ∪ fill layer). OSSJS draws nothing for a hovered mask.

title: MASK mode: hover the parent of a junction
what: Mask mode uses the identical footprint (body + circle + side line). Same gap as select mode.

title: MASK mode: hover an unfolded child
what: Inner start fill circle must be part of the yellow area and of the clickable area.
